statusMeaning.already exact: The named producer field and its local completeness state already carry the stated fact exactly; policy 2 may consume it only after every separately listed snapshot or session binding demand succeeds.
statusMeaning.producer extension required: A nearby producer owns the fact, but the named binding or completeness guarantee does not yet exist and must be added before certification.
statusMeaning.unsupported: No current authoritative producer can prove this demand; the exact subject remains open or is refused.
